title: 134. Distinct Subsequences

examples.explanation: The number of distinct subsequences of "rabbbit" equalling "rabbit" is 3.
The number of distinct subsequences of "babgbag" equalling "bag" is 5.

hints: For each source character, either skip it or use it to match the next target character.
Update target-prefix counts from right to left so one source character is not reused.
